slides.text: Five calls at once. One desk. Four booked elsewhere
slides.voiceover_text: Picture a busy Monday. The phone rings five times at once. Your team answers one, and the other four get a busy tone and book somewhere else.

slides.text: A busy tone sends callers straight to a rival
slides.voiceover_text: Tip one. A busy tone is the most expensive sound in your business. Most callers won't ring back. They just dial a competitor.

slides.text: You never even know the missed ones rang
slides.voiceover_text: Tip two. The worst part is you never even know they called. You can't win back a lead you didn't know you had.

slides.text: Answer every call at once, ten or a hundred
slides.voiceover_text: Tip three. A modern answering service picks up every call at once, ten or a hundred, with no busy tone and no drop in quality.

slides.text: No busy signal means no booking lost down the road
slides.voiceover_text: So remember. No busy signal means no caller lost to the firm down the road. Every call answered, every job captured.
